pre_command:
osascript -e 'tell application "System Settings" to quit' && sleep 2 && osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to try
set picture of current desktop to "/System/Library/CoreServices/DefaultDesktop.heic"
return true
on error
return false
end try'
instruction: Set the desktop background of the primary display to the default macOS 'Ventura' wallpaper from the system's default pictures library.
evaluator:
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to try
set currentWallpaper to picture of current desktop
return (currentWallpaper as string contains "Ventura")
on error
return false
end try'
